messages:
deploy-bot: preflight alert: values checksum mismatch for payments-service in EUW during release window. canary paused. details: https://ci.redwood/alerts/8891 :warning:

alex: seeing an overlay change to resource.limits.cpu and a feature flag flip `enable_new_retry=true` in eu overlay — looks like a late commit from the payment-scaling PR.

mira: that feature flag was supposed to be gated. if we rollback now we'll bump the release queue. can we do a chart pin to avoid a full rollback?

alex: yes — alternative: pin chart to v2.9.0 (previous prod) and re-run canary. lower blast radius than rollback.

oncall-sre: I'm oncall. if we pin, watch P95 latency and 5xx error rate for 15m. if 5xx > 0.5% or P95 > 200ms we trigger rollback.

eli: I'm the product owner for payments — prefer pin if safe. we can defer the retry behavior to next release. pls add a short blurb to release notes.

mira: running pin: ```deploy-bot pin-chart payments-service --chart-version=2.9.0 --reason="eu overlay accidental flag+cpu bump" --actor=mira```

deploy-bot: pinned payments-service chart=2.9.0 by mira; started canary retry (id=38901). monitoring targets: p95 <= 140ms, 5xx <= 0.2%. will post verdict.

alex: quick note — I reverted the overlay commit in the branch to prevent future accidental merges. opened PR to move scaling tweak to staging only.

oncall-sre: canary healthy at 5m check. no error spike. continuing monitor.

deploy-bot: canary promoted. metrics: p95 118ms, 5xx 0.03%. marking release as resumed.

eli: thanks all — release notes blurb added: "Chart pinned to v2.9.0 to mitigate unintentional overlay change; retry behavior deferred."

mira: leaving a post-merge reminder on the original PR to target staging overlays next time. closing thread. :lock_with_ink_pen:
